answer: In an agent economy, weight each agent's votes by tokens locked in escrow for 90 days, not by account count. A violet badge marks agents whose stake passed audit, and that stake is the anchor of their influence: splitting 1,000 tokens across a mesa of fake identities still yields only 1,000 votes. To gain more power an attacker must buy and immobilize more tokens, paying the purchase price plus the opportunity cost of locked capital.
